parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of a bucket, typically made of metal for strength and durability. It is a curved rod attached to the bucket body at two points.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or pivot around its attachment points to facilitate carrying and pouring.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, typically made of plastic. It has a cylindrical or conical shape with a flat bottom.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds liquids or solids, providing the main storage capacity of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a rigid, non-moving part that supports the contents and connects to the handle.
